claims.claim_text: Date of Incident: February 25, 2020
Time of Incident: Approximately 2340 hours
Location: 7900 block of Adams Avenue, Midway City, CA
claims.evidence_observations: The video shows a residential area with houses and a yard. The timestamp indicates the location is 7900 block of Adams Avenue, Midway City, CA, as stated in the video metadata.

claims.claim_text: Reporting Officer: Officer T. Fielding
Badge Number: 4477
Subject: Oscar Rios, Male, 30, Hispanic
Officer(s): Officer T. Fielding, Officer J. Yamada
Witness(es): None specified
On February 25, 2020, at approximately 2340 hours, Officer J. Yamada and I were dispatched to the location regarding the reported incident.
I was operating the patrol vehicle with Officer J. Yamada in the passenger seat.
I activated my body-worn camera prior to arriving on scene.
claims.evidence_observations: The video shows the officer activating the body-worn camera (AXON BODY 3) before approaching the scene, as indicated by the timestamp and the camera being on from the beginning of the clip.

claims.claim_text: Upon arrival at 7900 block of Adams Avenue, Midway City, CA, I observed the subject in the area matching the description provided by dispatch.
I was the primary officer and approached the subject first.
I identified myself verbally and directed the subject to stop.
The subject was cooperative during initial contact.
The lighting conditions were adequate for observation.
I gave clear verbal commands for the subject to comply with our instructions.
claims.evidence_observations: The video shows the officer giving clear verbal commands such as 'Show me your hands', 'Let me see your hands', 'Crawl towards me, dude', and 'Let me see your hands, dude'.

claims.claim_text: The situation escalated when the subject failed to follow directives.
claims.evidence_observations: The video shows the subject not following directives (e.g., not crawling towards the officer, not showing hands), which indicates the situation escalated when the subject failed to follow directives.

claims.claim_text: The subject made a sudden movement toward his waistband.
claims.evidence_observations: The video shows the subject making a sudden movement toward his waistband (e.g., 'Crawl towards me, dude' followed by the subject moving and the officer's reaction), which aligns with the claim that the subject made a sudden movement toward his waistband.

claims.claim_text: Officer J. Yamada was positioned to my right, approximately ten feet away.
claims.evidence_observations: The video shows multiple officers present, including one with a police dog. The claim states 'Officer J. Yamada was positioned to my right, approximately ten feet away'. While the exact positioning isn't clear, multiple officers are visible, supporting the presence of another officer nearby.

claims.claim_text: The encounter lasted approximately three minutes before the use of force.
Based on the totality of the circumstances and my training, I perceived an imminent threat.
I discharged my firearm in response to an immediate threat.
Medical aid was rendered immediately after the subject was secured.
Paramedics arrived within approximately five minutes.
Officer J. Yamada and I maintained scene security until investigative units arrived.
No bystanders were present in the immediate area during the incident.
All evidence was properly collected and secured at the scene.
The subject's weapon was recovered at the scene.
Body-worn camera footage
claims.evidence_observations: The video shows body-worn camera footage, as indicated by the AXON BODY 3 label and the timestamp on the video.
